title: Under the Radar / Collage layouts

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Give experimental imagery a repeatable scaffold because variation becomes easier to recognize when some structure stays fixed.
strategic_value: The framed collage system can make an eclectic festival feel connected without making every piece identical.
demonstration: A large and two smaller layouts combine cutout figures, rotated text blocks and orange-and-blue headings inside black frames.
practical_value: Compare how collage elements rotate within stable outer boundaries.

content_islands.name: Large composition
content_islands.spec: Place the largest framed layout at left.

content_islands.name: Companion layouts
content_islands.spec: Stack two smaller alternatives at right, retaining the shared title and colored text accents.

reference_purposes.Expression: A large and two smaller layouts combine cutout figures, rotated text blocks and orange-and-blue headings inside black frames.
reference_purposes.Application: The festival’s heading, collage imagery and information blocks appear in several framed promotional formats.
